description: This file defines the internal class SiloManifestProvider responsible for creating and managing the silo's grain manifest and grain class map within the Orleans runtime. It includes methods to generate interface and grain manifests based on provided configurations and providers.

classes.name: SiloManifestProvider
classes.description: Internal class responsible for creating and providing the silo's grain manifest and grain class map based on configuration and providers.

methods.name: SiloManifestProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the silo manifest and grain type map using provided grain property and interface providers, options, and resolvers.

methods.name: CreateInterfaceManifest
methods.description: Static method to create an immutable dictionary of grain interface types to their properties, based on provided property providers and interface options.

methods.name: CreateGrainManifest
methods.description: Static method to create grain properties and type mappings for each grain class based on provided property providers and options.
